LESSON: VISUAL DISCRIMINATION

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: READING
Topic 3.4: Visual discrimination

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Visual discrimination. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: VISUAL DISCRIMINATION
This lesson teaches Visual discrimination for PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Visual discrimination using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Visual discrimination above.
2. Explain Visual discrimination to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Visual discrimination.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Visual discrimination with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Visual discrimination important for a PP2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Match and pair pictures and puzzles among other visual objects at home and at school. discrimination activities

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
